description: The body saves independently. Article properties remain in the table.
emptyDescription: Write an article and add images here. The body stays separate from table fields and loads only when opened.
heading: Heading {{level}}
restoreDirty: Save your draft first. For a conflict, export the draft and load the server version before restoring history.
draftRetained: Unsaved drafts stay in this browser tab. Reopen to continue.
budget: Body: 64 KiB, 4,000 nodes, 12 levels, 20 images. Images: 5 MiB each; 40 uploads / 50 MiB total per body.
downloadAndReload: Export draft and load server version
draftStorageFailed: Your browser cannot retain this draft. Keep this window open and retry saving.
pasteImages: Pasted external images are not saved. Use Upload image to add private images.
pasteNotice: Pasted content was converted to supported formatting. External images, tables and unknown attributes may be lost; review the result.
saveBeforeImage: Save the body before uploading an image.
imageBudget: Each image must be at most 5 MiB.
linkHint: Use a full https://, http:// or mailto: URL. Clear the address to remove the link.

errors.BAD_INPUT: Unsupported body nodes, attributes or links, or content exceeds the budget. Review and retry.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Record, body or image not found within your authorized scope.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This body operation is not authorized.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Another client saved a newer version. Your draft is retained. Review the server version and export your draft before continuing.
errors.ALREADY_EXISTS: This record already has a body. Close and reopen it.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: The retry identifier does not match the original request. Retain your draft and reopen.
errors.ATTACHMENT_LIMIT: Body attachment budget exceeded: 40 files or 50 MiB total.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Image storage is unavailable. Please retry.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: Body request failed. Your draft is retained. Please retry.
